title: Enhancing Human Pose Estimation in Ancient Vase Paintings via Perceptually-grounded Style Transfer Learning
venueFull: ACM Journal on Computing and Cultural Heritage (JOCCH)
summary: Improves human pose estimation on ancient Greek vase paintings by fine-tuning on COCO person images style-transferred to the vase domain with a perceptually-grounded style-transfer loss. Further fine-tuning on a new annotated dataset (ClassArch) adds more gains; overall mAP and mAR rise by over 6%.
